item.title: [EN|In-Depth] BBC Global News Podcast (Sat 14:00): The Happy Pod: Why birdwatching is good for the brain
item.description:
Originally published Sat 28 Nov 2026 14:00 IST.

A new study reveals the simple act of birdwatching is good news for our brains and slows down signs of ageing. We hear from a professor who recently discovered that the activity of spotting and identifying birds can help slow down cognitive decline, and from a young birdwatcher who is passionate about it.

Also in this edition, the six rubbish collectors who saved a man's life. Jack was taking out his trash when he accidentally cut his wrist on the lid of a tin.

We meet the 15-year-old who has been described as 'the wonder kid of cricket'. Batter Vaibhav Sooryavanshi hit the most sixes ever recorded in a senior men's innings - scoring 204 runs from 53 balls while playing for India's A team against the United Arab Emirates. Plus, hear about the woman who has made history for Puerto Rico by becoming the first married woman and mother to win Miss Universe.

Image: Two Variegated Fairywren birds sat on a tree branch. Credit: Rosie Morley.

Our weekly collection of inspiring, uplifting and happy news from around the world.
